newsitem.title: JORDAN: Netanyahu in Jordan for talks with King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu in Jordan for talks with King Hussein.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived in Jordan's southern Red Sea resort of Aqaba on Wednesday for talks with King Hussein on the troubled Middle East peace process.

Witnesses said Netanyahu was greeted by Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Salam al-Majali as he stepped off an Israeli air force plane at Aqaba airport. The meeting with King Hussein will be his first with an Arab leader since a double suicide bombing in Jerusalem last month plunged Israeli-PLO ties into deep crisis.
